headline: Today has a new look and a new frame. Urgent lists the messages that need you now, each with one button, above your to-do lists. People shows your follow-ups and key relationships, and Priorities says which are moving. If your off-limits list cannot be read, the Hub names nobody and says so. An Update now rebuilds the page in one step where it can. Focus, the Today header and the new calendar rows come in the next release. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
